name: EMA 7/21 Crossover Trend Following
description: Trend-following strategy that enters long positions when the 7-day EMA crosses above the 21-day EMA. Uses 2% stop loss with $1000 risk per trade. Trades 15 large-cap S&P 500 stocks over 4-year backtest period.
source:
# EMA 7/21 Crossover Trend Following Strategy
# Entry: 7 EMA crosses above 21 EMA
# Exit: 2% stop loss
# Risk: $1000 per trade

# Data source
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Calculate EMAs
ema_7 = ma(period=7, type=MAType.ema)(close)
ema_21 = ma(period=21, type=MAType.ema)(close)

# Crossover signal: 7 EMA crosses above 21 EMA
# Using crossunder with reversed inputs: when slow crosses under fast = fast crosses over slow
entry_signal = crossunder()(ema_21, ema_7)

# Crossunder signal for exits: 7 EMA crosses below 21 EMA
exit_signal = crossunder()(ema_7, ema_21)

# Convert pulse signals to held position using hold_until
in_position = hold_until()(enter=entry_signal, exit=exit_signal)

# Entry/Exit zone management
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=in_position)

# Risk-based position sizing
# Risk $1000 per trade = 1% of $100,000 portfolio
# Stop distance = 2% of price
stop_dist = close * 0.02
risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.price)(
    risk_pct=1.0,
    stop_distance=stop_dist
)

# Visualize EMAs
timeseries_lines(
    title="Price and EMAs",
    category="Indicators",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Close", color=Color.Gray),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="7 EMA", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="21 EMA", color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(close, ema_7, ema_21)
